title: iris stolonifera var. vaga
intro: Iris stolonifera var. vaga, commonly known as Japanese Iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the iris family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Iris include reducing pain and swelling, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
